name: ate_backtest
description: Backtest a custom strategy on past data (read-only): HashKey Chain mainnet pool prices from Swap logs, HashKey Global prices and oracle rounds, with simulated fills (pool impact + 0.30% fee) and this vault's limits and safety rules. Returns plain numbers (P&L, trades, win rate, worst dip, fees, time in market), just holding, the current settings, the strategy as sentences and notes on data coverage. Omit strategyId and specJson to list the user's saved strategies. specJson is a flow.strategy/v1 spec: {name, kind: rules|ai, markets: [HSK|BTC], barMinutes?, entry: {when: all|any, conditions: [{signal, op: above|below|between, value, value2?, period?, windowMin?}]}, exit: {conditions?, takeProfitPct?, stopLossPct?, trailingStopPct?, maxHoldHours?}, sizing: {mode: usd|pct, value}, limits: {maxTradesPerDay, cooldownMin}, instructions?}; signals gap_cex, gap_oracle, change, ema, sma, vwap, rsi, bollinger, hour, pnl (values in %). Say results are simulated, not a promise.

specJson.description: A strategy spec as JSON text (to test before saving)
